opt_backup_help.message: Encrypted backups are recommended. If you forget the backup password, the file can't be opened.

opt_backup_tip.message:
When you export, a "Save As" dialog lets you choose where to save.
CSV files aren't encrypted. Anyone who opens one can see the passwords, so keep it somewhere safe.
The CSV format is the same as what Chrome and Edge export.

opt_move_title.message: Move passwords to and from the browser

opt_move_help.message: Use a CSV file to move passwords to and from the browser's built-in password manager. Nothing syncs automatically. When you're done, delete the CSV file and empty the Recycle Bin.

opt_move_in_title.message: Bring passwords in from the browser

opt_move_in_1a.message: Open the browser's password page. In the address bar, type this for Chrome:
opt_move_in_1a.description: One sentence split around three addresses: [1a] chrome://password-manager/settings[1b] edge://settings/passwords[1c] about:logins[1d]. A space follows 1a, 1b and 1c.

opt_move_in_1b.description: See opt_move_in_1a. Comes right after the Chrome address.

opt_move_in_1c.description: See opt_move_in_1a. Comes right after the Edge address.

opt_move_in_1d.description: See opt_move_in_1a. Comes right after the Firefox address.

opt_move_in_2.message: Find "Export passwords" and save a CSV file. The browser may ask for your Windows password or PIN first.
opt_move_in_2.description: 'Export passwords' is the browser's own button name.

opt_move_in_3.message: Come back here, click "Import CSV" above, and choose that file. Files exported from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari all work.

opt_move_out_title.message: Move passwords from here back to the browser

opt_move_out_1.message: Click "Export CSV" above to save a file. More than 3000 entries are split into several files, because Chrome and Edge accept at most 3000 at a time.

opt_move_out_2.message: Open the browser's password page (same address as above), find "Import passwords", and choose the file you just saved.
opt_move_out_2.description: 'Import passwords' is the browser's own button name.

opt_move_out_3.message: If the browser already has the same site and username with a different password, newer versions of Chrome list them and let you choose whether to replace them. If it doesn't ask, the browser keeps the password it already has.

opt_move_what_title.message: What happens when you move passwords back and forth

opt_move_what_1.message: Entries with the same site and username are merged, not duplicated. If the password is different, the one in the file is used and the original is kept in "Previous passwords".

opt_move_what_2.message: If the password in the file is an old one you've already replaced here, the one here is kept, not overwritten.

opt_move_what_3.message: If an entry in the file has no note, the note here isn't cleared.

opt_move_what_4b.message: entries) and other items that aren't sites aren't imported. They count as "skipped".
opt_move_what_4b.description: See opt_move_what_4a. 'skipped' is the count in the import result.

opt_move_what_5.message: If your organization has turned off the browser's password manager, you may not find export or import in the browser.

If the time is missed, the backup runs the next time you open the browser.

The popup, manager page, autofill on web pages, keyboard shortcut, and browser sign-in dialogs all require verification first.
Windows uses Windows Hello, Mac uses Touch ID, and other systems use a security key or phone. There's no backup PIN.
The manager page asks for verification every time you open it.
Locking doesn't encrypt the data on your disk.
If you move the extension's folder, turn it on again.

$1

opt_rule_no.description: $1 = position of the rule on its site.

opt_rule_text_cleared.message: Button text cleared. Only the selector is used now

opt_interval_placeholder.description: Placeholder of a small number input. $1 = default interval in seconds.

opt_rule_count_one.description: Shown next to the site name.

opt_rule_count_other.description: Shown next to the site name.

opt_rule_count_off_one.description: $1 = rules for the site, $2 = rules turned off.

opt_rule_count_off_other.description: $1 = rules for the site, $2 = rules turned off.

opt_rule_path_empty.message: Path can't be blank. Enter * for the whole site.

opt_rule_interval_invalid.message: Interval must be a whole number from 1 to 86400

opt_delete_all_help_before.message: Everything goes to the Trash first and can be restored within
opt_delete_all_help_before.description: Before the number of days: 'Everything goes to the Trash first and can be restored within [30] days.' Keep the trailing space in languages that use spaces.

opt_delete_all_help_after.description: After the number of days. See opt_delete_all_help_before.

opt_confirm_delete_all_one.message: Move $1 password to the Trash? You can restore it within $2 days.
opt_confirm_delete_all_one.description: $1 = number of passwords, $2 = days items stay in the Trash.

opt_confirm_delete_all_other.message: Move all $1 passwords to the Trash? You can restore them within $2 days.
opt_confirm_delete_all_other.description: $1 = number of passwords, $2 = days items stay in the Trash.

opt_help_1.message: Sign in to any site once, and you'll be asked "Save this password?" in the top-right corner.
opt_help_1.description: The quoted text is the save prompt shown on web pages (content.js). Keep it the same as that prompt.

opt_help_2.message: The next time you open that site, your username and password are filled in automatically. If you saved several accounts, click the username field to choose from a list. Use the arrow keys to pick one and Enter to fill it.

opt_help_3.message: Press Ctrl+Shift+L (Command+Shift+L on Mac) to fill in the username and password for the current site. You can change the shortcut under "Keyboard shortcuts" on the extensions page.
opt_help_3.description: 'Keyboard shortcuts' is the browser's own page name.

opt_help_4.message: With the blue lock icon on the toolbar, you can see the accounts saved for the current site, fill them in manually, copy passwords, and generate strong passwords. The search box at the top of the popup searches accounts on all sites. Press Enter to open that site.

opt_help_5.message: When you sign up or change a password, click the new password field to see "Generate a strong password". Click it to fill in both the new password and the confirmation field.
opt_help_5.description: The quoted text is an item shown on web pages (content.js). Keep it the same as that item.

opt_help_6.message: To click a button automatically, click "Pick a button to auto-click" in the popup and select the button on the page. From then on, it's clicked whenever you open that page. You can also add and adjust rules manually under "Auto-click" on the "Settings" tab.

opt_help_7.message: For accounts whose password has changed, the password column has "Previous passwords", which you can expand. Deleted accounts go to the Trash first and stay there for 30 days by default. You can change the number of days on the Trash tab.

opt_help_8.message: When "App lock" on the "Settings" tab is on, you need to pass this computer's system verification (Windows Hello, Touch ID) before using any part of the extension. It locks when you're idle, when the browser restarts, or when you click "Lock" in the popup.

opt_help_9.message: Back up regularly, or turn on auto backup. Your passwords are lost if you remove the extension, clear browsing data, or move its folder.

opt_browser_hint.message: You're using $1. The extensions page is at $2. After you update the files, click "Reload" there.
opt_browser_hint.description: $1 = 'Edge' or 'Chrome', $2 = edge://extensions or chrome://extensions. 'Reload' is the browser's own button name.

opt_version_now.message: Current version: $1. After you update the files, click "Reload" on the extensions page.

opt_version_current.description: Badge next to the installed version in the list.

opt_version_note.description: $1 = one note of a version from changelog.js.

cs_err_ext_reloaded.message: The extension was reloaded. Refresh this page.
cs_err_ext_reloaded.description: Error when the extension was reloaded or updated while this page stayed open. Usually shown after "Couldn't save: ".

cs_err_no_response.description: Error when the extension's background service worker didn't answer. Usually shown after "Couldn't save: ".

cs_save.description: Button on the save-password card and on the auto-click confirmation card.

cs_cancel.description: Button on the auto-click confirmation card.

cs_banner_save_title.description: Title of the card shown on the web page after signing in.

cs_banner_update_title.message: Update the password for this account?
cs_banner_update_title.description: Title of the same card when the site already has this account saved with a different password.

cs_banner_show.description: Small button inside the password box that reveals the password. Keep it short.

cs_banner_hide.description: Same button after the password is revealed. Keep it short.

cs_banner_never.description: Link-style button on the save-password card. Stops asking to save passwords on this site.

cs_banner_no.description: Closes the save-password card without saving.

cs_banner_never_done.message: Won't ask again on $1. You can change this on the manager page.
cs_banner_never_done.description: $1 is the site's host name, for example accounts.example.com.

cs_generate_no_field.message: Couldn't find a new password field to fill

cs_generate_filled_copied.message: Filled in the generated password and copied it to the clipboard. After you submit, remember to click "Save".
cs_generate_filled_copied.description: "Save" is the button on the save-password card that appears after the form is submitted.

cs_generate_filled.message: Filled in the generated password. After you submit, remember to click "Save".
cs_generate_filled.description: Same as cs_generate_filled_copied, when copying to the clipboard wasn't allowed.

cs_dropdown_locked.message: Locked. Click the lock icon in the toolbar and verify it's you to autofill.
cs_dropdown_locked.description: Shown under a sign-in field while App lock is locked.

cs_dropdown_choose_account.message: $1 — choose an account to fill in
cs_dropdown_choose_account.description: Header of the account list under a sign-in field. $1 is the extension name (Password Keeper).

cs_dropdown_generate.description: Item in the list under a new-password field.

cs_dropdown_generate_hint.message: Fills the new and confirm password fields. Options are in the toolbar popup.
cs_dropdown_generate_hint.description: Second line under "Generate a strong password". Options means the password generator options.

cs_dropdown_no_username.description: Shown in the account list for a saved login without a username.

cs_click_cooldown.message: Auto-clicked just now. Skipping this time.

cs_click_after_logout.message: You just signed out. Skipping auto-click this time.

cs_click_missed_stop.description: $1 is the button text (up to 20 characters). The rule is set to stop when its button is missing, so the rules after it on this page are skipped.

cs_click_button_fallback.description: Used as $1 in the auto-click messages when the button has no text.

cs_click_done.description: $1 is the button text (up to 20 characters).

cs_click_not_found.message: Couldn't find the button to auto-click

cs_click_empty_field.message: Some form fields are still empty. Skipped auto-click this time.

cs_pick_hint.message: Click the button you want to auto-click. Press Esc to cancel.
cs_pick_hint.description: Hint at the top of the web page while picking a button to auto-click.

cs_pick_untrusted_frame.message: This part is embedded from another site and can't be auto-clicked
cs_pick_untrusted_frame.description: The picked button is inside a frame embedded from a different site.

cs_pick_title.description: Title of the card shown after picking a button to auto-click.

cs_pick_button.description: Label above the picked button's text.

cs_pick_no_text.description: Shown when the picked button has no text.

cs_pick_note_no_account.message: No account saved for this site yet. It'll click after you save one.

cs_pick_note_autofill_off.message: Autofill is off for this site. It'll click after you turn it on.

cs_pick_after_fill.description: Option for when to click: after the username and password are autofilled.

cs_pick_on_load.message: As soon as the page opens

cs_pick_saved.message: Saved. It'll auto-click next time you open this page.

cs_fill_no_fields.message: No sign-in fields found on this page
cs_fill_no_fields.description: Shown in the popup when "Fill" can't find a sign-in form on the page.

cs_fill_failed.description: Shown in the popup when filling the page failed.

bg_vault_unreadable.message: Can't decrypt your password data. The storage may be damaged. You can clear all data on the manager page and start over.

bg_url_scheme_unsupported.message: Only sites that start with http or https can be saved

bg_duplicate_account.message: This username is already saved for this site

bg_webauthn_wrong_origin.message: Verification didn't come from this extension

bg_webauthn_not_set_up.message: System verification isn't set up yet

bg_webauthn_unknown_key.message: This key isn't registered with this extension
bg_webauthn_unknown_key.description: The key is the passkey created for app lock (Windows Hello, Touch ID, a security key or phone).

bg_webauthn_no_user_verification.message: Your identity wasn't verified (PIN, fingerprint, or face)

bg_gen_symbols_empty.message: Symbols are selected, but the list of allowed symbols is empty
bg_gen_symbols_empty.description: Password generator in the popup: the symbols checkbox is on but the allowed symbols field is empty.

bg_gen_no_charset.message: Select at least one character type

bg_gen_too_short.message: Too short to include every character type

bg_backup_password_too_short.message: Backup password must be at least 8 characters

bg_not_backup_file.message: This isn't a Password Keeper backup file

bg_file_untracked.description: Shown under a file location in the backup history: the file can't be deleted from here because the browser's download history was cleared.

bg_file_missing.description: Shown under a file location in the backup history: the file was moved or deleted.

bg_download_interrupted_reason.description: $1 is the browser's reason code, like USER_CANCELED.

bg_backup_location_changed.message: Auto backup location changed from "$1" to "$2". Earlier files stay in the old location.
bg_backup_location_changed.description: Saved in the backup history when the auto backup folder changes, in the language in use at that time. $1 is the old folder, $2 is the new folder.

bg_enable_needs_password.message: Set an auto backup password before turning this on

bg_auto_backup_no_password.message: Auto backup password isn't set yet
bg_auto_backup_no_password.description: Also saved as the last auto backup error, in the language in use at that time.

bg_backup_file_auto.description: File name, without the .pkbak extension, of a scheduled auto backup. $1 is the date and time, like 20261106-1200. Don't use these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

bg_backup_file_now.description: File name, without the .pkbak extension, of a backup made with "Back up now". $1 is the date and time, like 20261106-1200. Don't use these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |

bg_badge_locked.description: Badge text on the toolbar icon while the extension is locked. The badge fits only about 4 characters.

bg_rule_path_required.message: Path can't be blank. Enter * for the whole site.

bg_seconds_range.message: $1 must be a whole number from $2 to $3
bg_seconds_range.description: $1 is a field name (bg_label_interval or bg_label_pause). $2 and $3 are the minimum and maximum number of seconds.

bg_label_interval.description: Field name used as $1 in bg_seconds_range: seconds to wait before auto-clicking the same button again.

bg_label_pause.description: Field name used as $1 in bg_seconds_range: the "pause after sign-out" seconds on the manager page.

bg_duplicate_click_rule.message: This path already has a rule with the same selector

bg_autofill_off_for_site.message: Autofill is off for this site. Turn it on first.

bg_rules_changed.message: Rules have changed. Reload this page.

bg_trash_not_found.message: This item isn't in the Trash

bg_restore_duplicate.message: This username is already saved for this site. Delete that account first to restore this one.

bg_log_not_found.message: This record wasn't found. It may have been deleted.

bg_locked.message: Locked. Click the lock icon on the toolbar to verify it's you.
bg_locked.description: The lock icon is this extension's icon on the browser toolbar.

bg_unknown_message.description: $1 is an internal message type. Only shown when something inside the extension goes wrong.

lang_name_zh_TW.description: Shown in the language menu. Always written in that language itself, so people can find their language.

lang_name_en.description: Shown in the language menu. Always written in that language itself, so people can find their language.

lang_name_ja.description: Shown in the language menu. Always written in that language itself, so people can find their language.

opt_lang_auto.description: Language menu option that follows the browser. $1 is the language the browser picked, e.g. English.
